description:
At 5:20 PM WTC 7 collapsed, after being set ablaze by the falling WTC 1 at 10:28 AM. The building had been completely evacuated. 
For a list of video sources, see https://web.archive.org/web/20200701115823/http://www.911conspiracy.tv/7_WTC.html
The final clip (which isn't counted as one of the 27) comes from: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FG-UkJ1FMTU
"9/11: As It Happened - from Brooklyn, Collapse of 7WTC"
Also the Richard Peskin video isn't counted as one of the 27, since the collapse isn't captured (seen at 7:15) However, the MSNBC clip near the end is counted even though the collapse isn't captured. In another video I synched the MSNBC video with 3 others to see where the building was in its collapse when Ashleigh and others were reacting -- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c299M9D9t5U
